title: Farming Life in Another World
description: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!

episodes.title: S1-E8The Researcher and The Two Princesses

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Hikaru won’t waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku’s loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Now that they’ve secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Hikaru realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village’s case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Hiraku’s offhand comment leads to a series of events that end with a merchant setting up a trade deal with The Great Tree Village.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. "Attempts" being the keyword.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren’t the only ones interested in the good news.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Hiraku’s second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

episodes_data.title: Farming Life in Another World Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.
